blocks.text: useSeoMeta describes title and description values for a page. Nuxt can include them in the generated document head.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `useSeoMeta` gives Nuxt the page metadata it can include during rendering or generation.

blocks.text: The browser tab and generated page metadata use the supplied title and description.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep the title and description about the actual page. Metadata does not replace visible content.
